classification.difficultyReason: Apply the taught standardisation method to two scores and interpret the larger positive z-score as better relative performance; equal scores and means simplify the comparison.

content.prompt: Kathryn scored 78% on both her history and mathematics tests. Both tests had a class mean of 70%, but history had a standard deviation of 8% and mathematics had a standard deviation of 12%. In which test did Kathryn perform better relative to the rest of the class?

answer.short: History: Kathryn scored $1$ standard deviation above the mean, compared with $\frac{2}{3}$ of a standard deviation above the mean in mathematics.
answer.worked:
History:
$$\begin{aligned}z_{\text{history}}&=\frac{78-70}{8}\\z_{\text{history}}&=1\end{aligned}$$
Mathematics:
$$\begin{aligned}z_{\text{mathematics}}&=\frac{78-70}{12}\\z_{\text{mathematics}}&=\frac{2}{3}\end{aligned}$$
Kathryn performed better in history relative to the class because her score was more standard deviations above the mean.
